chunks: We narrate to you the best of narratives in what We have revealed to you, this Qur'an; and if you were before it, indeed, among the unaware.
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Ahsan al-Qasas' (The Best of Narratives) refer to in the Qur'an?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is viewed as a divine guarantee of the narrative's coherence and truth, distinguishing it from mere folklore by its prophetic origin. It underscores the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) *ghaflah* (unawareness) of these specific details prior to revelation, affirming the Qur'an's status as a comprehensive guide where the story of Yusuf serves as a paradigm for patience and divine providence.
